summary: Both halves inspected; the sloping marginal note was enlarged and rotated for reading. It reads we may however work with the inverse limit of corr. sheaves, with may rather than can, an explicit left arrow below lim, and the abbreviation corr. The main text still warns that W-linearization is only proadjoint and would require prosheaves. The V-case instead uses affine schemes and adjunction for quasicoherent sheaves. LH. is a baseline full stop, not a subscript. The final ts in objects is clipped and remains uncertain; the c/x overprint in Spec k and an earlier letter under let remain unresolved.
